correctness.rationale: Exact d+2 facet-support inequalities reduce John optimization to the one-variable log-concave factor s(1-2s)^((d-1)/2), with unique solution and threshold. For Löwner, each vertex has exactly unit gauge and positive vertex weights of mean center and covariance Q/d supply the sufficient contact moments; hence global uniqueness. The ratio derivative is explicitly negative and endpoint and second-derivative computations are algebraic. The package verifier passed 225 parameter checks; a separate numerical constrained optimizer passed 24 problems and is not used as an infinite proof.
